3
A skydiver jumps from an aeroplane and falls towards the Earth.
Which statement is correct when the skydiver has reached terminal velocity?
A
The skydiver’s speed is decreasing.
B
The skydiver’s speed is increasing.
C
The skydiver is moving with constant speed.
D
The skydiver’s speed is zero.

options.label: C
options.text: The skydiver is moving with constant speed.
